item.title: The 15 Most Iconic Bridal Gowns Of Horror
item.description: To celebrate Maggie Gyllenhaal’s THE BRIDE! hitting theaters today, we’re going down the aisle to revisit horror’s best and most beautiful bridal gowns.

item.title: How THE BRIDE! Was Filmed

item.title: THE BRIDE! Disappointed Greatly At The Box Office

item.title: Listen To The Horrors of UNDERTONE On New In-Universe Website

item.title: Thank You, Joe Bob Briggs: Saying Goodbye To THE LAST DRIVE-IN
item.description: The drive-in will never die, but Joe Bob Briggs and Darcy the Mail Girl’s time with THE LAST DRIVE-IN on Shudder is coming to an end. We thank them for seven seasons worth of memories.

item.title: FATAL FRAME II: CRIMSON BUTTERFLY Is A Tantalizing Horror Game With One Fatal Flaw
item.description: The FATAL FRAME II: CRIMSON BUTTERFLY remake goes above and beyond by staying faithful to what made the original so revered, while also trying new things.
